Varterm TTS
https://varterm.com

Summary:
- Free text to speech converter with long-form support and markdown cleanup.
- No signup required. Unlimited usage on the main web reader.
- Text to speech for web, Cursor, VS Code, and Chrome workflows.
- Editor Auto-read plays the agent window when a reply finishes. Highlight text to hear it. Play, pause, stop, jump, and change speed or voice from the status bar. Current editor build: 0.1.49.
- Chrome reads a selection, a page, or a video transcript. Search the words, jump, change speed, and optionally hear new AI chat replies as they finish.
